description: A check of about 8 to 10 minutes for finance staff, taken after the awareness episodes (pair AB). Ten new messages from the payments inbox of Brightwell Foods, a fictional company, matched to your starting check. The end screen compares the two results once you have done it.
organiser_note: each role's check tests the channel that role meets in its episode, and in a session that runs more than one episode only the learner's primary-role check is recorded.
